name: Lasya
source: One of the five gynoids containing [url=/c7182]Ruili[/url]'s soul data.  Lasya belongs to [url=/c7187]Bin Weixin[/url] - a memento of the rape and murder of Kong Ruili one year prior. Not much is known about her.
